# Noetic Organism Omega (v2.2.0)

> Cross-OS bit-identical portable C11 whole-organism cognitive engine (6,776 B/world), 825-check & 100-milestone Clean-Slate v3.0 falsification harness, and 68-theorem 6-kernel Palomar Lean 4.35.0 proof suite (`Ledger10` + 11-slot `Ledger11` + `AdversarialTests.lean`).

Epistemic Notice: Not peer-reviewed; AI-assisted under human direction; 29 cognitive checks are strictly [INDICATOR-ONLY]; 0/1,900 Mega-Atlas problems retired; 18 of 68 Lean theorems are explicitly labeled bookkeeping numeral identities.
